positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and implementation of the billing platform, in charge of payment processing, funds distributions, refunds, and fee collection using Stripe as the payment processor.
• Redesign of background jobs implementation that complies with process safety and scalability.
• Design and implementation of an ETL system for analytics data connecting to Business Intelligence tools.
• Day-to-day operations including code reviews, mentoring, miscellaneous application improvements, and investigating platform and billing incidents.
• Relevant technologies: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, React, Redux, Typescript, Heroku, CircleCI.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesign and implementation of the Mail Merge feature, renamed to Sequences, a flagship feature of the Mixmax platform, which paved the way to support thousands of recipients per campaign compared to a previous limit of 20 recipients, improved user customization, scalability, performance, and flexibility to build new features on top of it.
• Design and implementation of the Tasks feature, which supported a seamless integration with the Salesforce platform for users in the Enterprise plan.
• Contributions to the NodeJS queue library Bull, specifically bugfixes and reliability improvements.
• Major improvements on database querying performance, particularly on systems that fed live data and analytics into the application.
• Layer 1 & 2 for on-call rotation where I handled severe outages on our application or third-party providers to minor day-to-day incidents.
• Relevant technologies: NodeJS, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, AWS, CircleCI, Travis, React, Websockets.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead engineer at Gathr Films, where I worked on the website redesign, a subscription service for movie screenings, and major improvements on scalability.
• Lead engineer at Incroud, where I worked on the user dashboard where users were able to upload their music snippets, also implemented a live chat for personalities user to communicate with their followers.
• Mentorship with interns and junior engineers.
• Team lead of various short-lived projects within the company.
• Relevant technologies: PHP, NodeJS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, CassandraDB, AWS, jQuery, AngularJS, Socket.IO

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented processes for quality assurance on the automotive vertical of Internet Brands which encompassed websites with
car listings, user forums, and automated tools.
• Pioneered the automation testing effort in the company and trained other QA engineers on these tools for use in other verticals.
• Took over team lead duties, leading a distributed team working in the QA team in the automotive vertical.
• Relevant technologies: Selenium, Robotframework, Jenkins.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
• Implementation and support of the RMA platform of the company.
• Implemented the first version of a user dashboard where they could see all their purchase history and bills on a digital platform.
Previous to this everything was handled entirely by paper.
• Maintenance of legacy systems running software implemented on COBOL.
• Relevant technologies: PHP, C#, VisualBasic, MSSQL, Cobol, Linux, Windows Server.
